factor: Entry opportunity only: compare first versus the first subsequent same-direction closed 12H V1.7 reclaim of the identical New York week 1.618 boundary. This study compares replacement of the original entry with the second, not adding a second live position. The second can be identified only when it actually closes.
signal_clock: Use the original V1.7 parent key and same frozen Monday range. Scan later confirmed native 12H bars in strictly chronological order. Require a genuinely new wick crossing of the same 1.618 boundary and a close strictly inside the Monday extensions with the original side's confirmed EMA20/50; a candle entirely outside or a boundary touch without a reclaim does not qualify. No next-week anchor. The secondary confirmation must be strictly later than the first and strictly before week expiration; at most one second opportunity per symbol/week. The first original key can be detected without knowing whether a second will ever occur.
admission: Compute every secondary entry's 90-day eligibility at its own clock and its own prior 12H ATR. Nine concurrent cash-sharing slots with the previously frozen low prior ATR priority. Trade at the first observed H1 opening quote on confirmation; do not carry forward the parent's entry, stop, target or outcome to price the secondary event. Recompute each original V1.7 stop with the same Monday anchor and the new 12H key; all 2R distances measured from actual new open.
capital: 1000U. Use the previously tested two-thirds resting 2R partial and one-third original cloud runner. One actual position per symbol. 5bp taker and 2bp maker per fill, plus separate 5bp stress. Do not use the future appearance of a second reclaim to condition the executable primary comparator; matched-parent comparisons may be reported only as retrospective diagnostics.
scope: OKX frozen 2020-01-24 to 2026-11-08. Use actual archived 12H and H1 data; audit first-key identities against the existing ledger, preserve right-censored weeks as incomplete. Reuse existing VectorBT path and funding adapters. If qualified, transfer the frozen rule to corrected Binance history. The original 12H account and 90-day universe have already been selected on previously explored history.
decision: Report funded full-period wealth, realized USDT payoff, return payoff, win rate, marked and conservative drawdown; development through 2024 and 2025/26 separately. If a new rule meets 30% wins, >=2.5 realized cash and return payoff, >=100 closed development trades, <=35% lifetime DD, run matched noise and stress. The user wealth goal remains >1000 times net profit from 1000U.
feasibility: Read-only smoke screen on the first three symbols in the recorded input order: ICX 20/41, LRC 31/67 and 0G 13/20 weeks had a subsequent qualifying bar. These sample counts were observed before this registration. No funded results known at registration.
